name: Kiểm tra chất vải
actions: Full garment hanging on a matte-black hanger; camera slowly pushes in.
A realistic hand gently lifts the garment hem, creating natural folds.
The same hand pinches and inspects the fabric; camera approaches.
Extreme close-up of authentic fabric weave and seams, sharp focus for two seconds.
Hand releases fabric; folds relax; camera retreats.
Full garment reveal, stable closing frame.

name: Cầm móc áo POV
actions: A hand grips the silver hook of the hanger, full garment view.
Hand subtly rotates hanger, showing garment drape.
Camera approaches the neckline and upper fabric for a close-up.
Camera shifts to show seam and textile detail.
Pull back to full garment while hand holds hook.

name: Review nhanh
actions: Fast natural handheld full-product introduction.
Quick physical push toward chest detail.
Side-angle inspection with natural camera corrections.
Macro texture inspection with stable focus.
Energetic pull-back to full product reveal.

name: Logo & đường may
actions: Full garment establishing view.
Approach original logo or chest details if present; otherwise neckline.
Sharp inspection of original stitching and seam construction.
Show collar and authentic textile details.
Return to full garment view.

name: Premium tối giản
actions: Elegant slow full garment view.
Controlled push toward upper torso.
Gentle angled view to show silhouette.
Close-up of original fabric and stitching.
Smooth pullback to complete garment.

name: Giới thiệu sản phẩm
actions: Full garment view on fixed hanger.
Approach collar and upper body.
Move to hem and fabric texture.
Pull back to complete garment and finish.
